description: This Java class 'BuybackLoanFromExternalAssetOwnerHandler' handles commands related to buying back loans from external asset owners within the Fineract investor module. It implements a command handler interface and delegates the buyback operation to a service.

classes.name: BuybackLoanFromExternalAssetOwnerHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles buyback loan commands by delegating to an external asset owner write service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to perform a buyback loan operation for an external asset owner.
